short_description: Outbound dial requests stall during contact campaign bursts
description: Contact flows entered the outbound branch, but calls were not placed when scheduled campaign traffic overlapped. Lambda logs showed throttled invocations and later retries often completed.
close_notes: Restored outbound capacity and added an alarm for concurrency headroom.
root_cause: Reserved concurrency for the outbound orchestration Lambda was lower than the peak contact-flow burst, so valid invocations were throttled before the outbound API call.
resolution: Raised reserved concurrency to the tested campaign ceiling, enabled provisioned concurrency for the launch window, and added throttling and queue-depth alarms.

short_description: Campaign contacts remain pending after dialer release
description: The flow and function completed, while the outbound contact request intermittently exceeded its client deadline. The behavior began with a release that reduced downstream timeouts.
close_notes: Corrected the release configuration and verified repeated outbound call creation.
root_cause: A deployment set the outbound contact API client timeout below normal service latency and disabled the previous bounded retry policy.
resolution: Restored the validated client timeout, enabled exponential retry for transient timeouts, and added a release test that confirms contact creation rather than Lambda completion alone.

short_description: Amazon Connect outbound calls fail after Lambda deployment
description: The contact flow starts successfully and the Lambda invocation completes, but no outbound call is established. CloudWatch shows intermittent timeout errors, manual retry sometimes succeeds, and the issue began immediately after deployment.

short_description: Transferred callers disconnect before reaching specialist queue
description: Calls remained stable with the first agent, then ended immediately when the transfer-to-queue block executed. The target queue showed no new contacts.
close_notes: Repointed the transfer block and validated warm and cold transfers.
root_cause: The published contact flow referenced a retired queue after the specialist queues were renamed, leaving the transfer block with an invalid destination.
resolution: Updated the flow to the current queue, republished it, and added automated validation that every transfer destination exists and is enabled.

short_description: Warm transfers lose media after agent handoff
description: The destination agent accepted the contact, but both parties heard silence and the contact terminated moments later. Direct inbound calls were unaffected.
close_notes: Removed the obsolete media branch and confirmed transfer audio continuity.
root_cause: A legacy transfer branch stopped media streaming before the destination agent was joined, causing the contact to lose its media path during handoff.
resolution: Moved media shutdown after successful handoff, republished the contact flow, and added a transfer audio check to the release suite.

short_description: Customer calls end when agents transfer to billing
description: Inbound conversations are normal until an agent selects the billing transfer. The destination agent is briefly offered the contact, then the call disconnects before audio is established.

short_description: Order event processor reaches timeout during retry storms
description: Function duration climbed to its maximum while concurrent executions remained saturated. Duplicate downstream retries kept workers occupied and delayed fresh order events.
close_notes: Stopped the retry amplification and restored concurrency headroom.
root_cause: Synchronous retries lacked jitter and held Lambda environments until timeout, exhausting reserved concurrency and amplifying the backlog.
resolution: Replaced inline retries with bounded asynchronous retry, added jitter and idempotency, and alarmed on concurrent execution saturation.

short_description: Webhook Lambda throttles despite low average traffic
description: Short bursts produced throttles and API errors although the hourly request rate looked normal. Concurrency graphs reached a flat ceiling during each burst.
close_notes: Adjusted concurrency allocation and verified burst processing under load.
root_cause: A newly deployed function consumed the regional unreserved concurrency pool, leaving the webhook dispatcher without capacity during bursts.
resolution: Assigned reserved concurrency to both critical functions, capped the batch worker, and introduced a pre-deployment concurrency budget check.

short_description: Invoice worker times out as event backlog grows
description: Invoice events remain visible for repeated processing, function duration approaches the configured limit, and concurrent executions stay at capacity during the morning batch.

short_description: Recommendation requests receive bursts of model throttling
description: Embedding calls succeeded, but generation returned intermittent throttling during parallel investigations. Retrying after traffic subsided usually worked.
close_notes: Smoothed generation traffic and verified controlled retries under load.
root_cause: The investigation worker launched unbounded parallel generation calls and exceeded the model's available on-demand throughput.
resolution: Added a concurrency limiter, exponential backoff with jitter for throttling, and metrics separating embedding from generation failures.

short_description: Grounded analysis intermittently returns dependency errors
description: Vector retrieval completed consistently, while some recommendation calls failed before producing text. A second request often succeeded without data changes.
close_notes: Aligned client timeouts with the function budget and added safe transient retry.
root_cause: The Bedrock client read timeout was shorter than observed generation latency and transient service errors were not retried.
resolution: Set the client timeout within the Lambda execution budget, added one bounded retry for retryable errors, and published latency percentile alarms.

short_description: Incident recommendations fail intermittently under demo load
description: Similarity search completes, but occasional generation requests return a dependency error. Repeating the analysis later can return a normal recommendation.

short_description: Deployment workflow cannot assume AWS release role
description: Build and tests passed, but the deployment job failed at credential exchange. The workflow had recently moved to a reusable GitHub Actions definition.
close_notes: Corrected the federation conditions and completed a controlled deployment.
root_cause: The role trust policy required an audience claim that differed from the claim configured by the reusable workflow's OIDC request.
resolution: Aligned the OIDC audience and subject conditions, restricted them to the deployment branch, and added a preflight role-assumption job.

short_description: SAM release job packages an outdated Lambda artifact
description: The workflow reported success, yet the deployed function did not contain the latest handler change. The package checksum matched an earlier build.
close_notes: Separated dependency caching from build output and verified artifact provenance.
root_cause: The pipeline restored the generated SAM build directory from a broad cache key and deployed that stale artifact without rebuilding source.
resolution: Excluded generated build output from caches, required a fresh SAM build, and recorded the source commit and artifact digest in deployment metadata.

short_description: Main branch deployment fails after tests complete
description: The GitHub Actions workflow passes lint and unit tests, then fails during the release stage before CloudFormation begins updating the development stack.

short_description: Contact automation loses permission to start outbound calls
description: The Lambda function ran normally but every outbound contact request was denied after an execution-role cleanup. Contact flows continued to enter the integration branch.
close_notes: Restored the narrow Connect action and added an authorization canary.
root_cause: A role-policy refactor removed the specific Amazon Connect outbound contact action required by the orchestration Lambda.
resolution: Added the missing action for only the development Connect instance and introduced a deployment test that performs a non-customer synthetic authorization check.

short_description: Lambda cannot read integration credential after key rotation
description: Cold starts failed while loading the managed integration credential, while warm environments continued briefly. Secrets Manager access checks reported a decrypt denial.
close_notes: Corrected decrypt authorization and verified cold-start credential loading.
root_cause: The replacement encryption key policy did not include the Lambda execution role, so Secrets Manager could retrieve metadata but could not decrypt the secret value.
resolution: Granted the execution role decrypt permission only through Secrets Manager for the development secret and added a cold-start validation after rotations.

short_description: Incident API reports access denied while loading MCP credential
description: Health remains available, but data requests fail when a fresh Lambda environment attempts to load the managed repository credential from Secrets Manager.

short_description: Voicebot forgets verified intent between dialog turns
description: Callers completed verification, but the next utterance restarted the welcome prompt. Session traces showed the prior intent disappearing after a pause.
close_notes: Extended session retention and confirmed intent continuity across pauses.
root_cause: The session store expiration was shorter than the contact flow's allowed caller response window, deleting context before the next turn.
resolution: Aligned session expiration with the maximum conversation duration, refreshed it on each turn, and added a pause-duration regression test.

short_description: Returning callers are sent back to voicebot greeting
description: The bot recognized speech but could not recover the conversation state after a blue-green release. New sessions behaved correctly while sessions started before the release restarted.
close_notes: Restored compatible session lookup and completed cross-version dialog tests.
root_cause: The new release changed the session-key prefix without a compatibility read path, making in-progress context invisible to the new Lambda version.
resolution: Restored the stable prefix, added dual-read migration logic for existing sessions, and added blue-green continuity tests.

short_description: Voicebot repeats welcome prompt after collecting account intent
description: The caller selects an intent and hears the correct confirmation, but the following response returns to the initial greeting instead of continuing the dialog.

short_description: German callers route to default English support queue
description: Language detection returned German, but the routing flow used the default branch. Queue metrics showed unexpected German-language contacts in English support.
close_notes: Normalized language values and validated each supported routing branch.
root_cause: The detector emitted lowercase locale values while the contact flow compared uppercase values, so no localized branch matched.
resolution: Normalized locale attributes before routing, added an explicit fallback reason, and tested all supported locale variants.

short_description: Spanish voice contacts wait in the wrong queue
description: Spanish prompts played correctly, yet callers entered the general queue and wait time increased. The localized queue remained nearly empty.
close_notes: Corrected the queue mapping and confirmed localized queue occupancy.
root_cause: A configuration promotion mapped the Spanish locale to the general queue identifier instead of the localized support queue.
resolution: Corrected the environment mapping, validated queue identifiers during deployment, and added routing metrics grouped by detected locale.

short_description: French callers hear localized prompt but reach general support
description: The language prompt is French and the detected locale is present, but contacts appear in the general support queue instead of the configured French queue.

short_description: Analyze UI action receives forbidden response from backend
description: The ServiceNow button was visible and constructed a request, but API Gateway rejected every call before Lambda invocation. Other scoped application features were unaffected.
close_notes: Re-entered the private API key property and verified a protected request.
root_cause: The private ServiceNow API-key property was empty after the scoped application was installed on a refreshed development instance.
resolution: Loaded the generated development key into the private password property, kept it out of update sets, and added a post-install configuration checklist.

short_description: ServiceNow analysis request targets a nonexistent API path
description: Outbound REST execution returned not found while health checks against the base API succeeded. The configured endpoint contained the stage path twice.
close_notes: Corrected the full endpoint property and confirmed response parsing.
root_cause: The endpoint property already included the API stage, while a local configuration procedure appended the same stage a second time.
resolution: Stored the complete analysis endpoint exactly once, removed path concatenation from the setup procedure, and added an endpoint-format validation check.

short_description: Analyze action times out without adding work notes
description: The incident form action waits until the outbound REST timeout and displays a safe failure message. No recommendation is written to work notes.

short_description: Checkout latency rises as database sessions reach pool limit
description: Application latency increased while database CPU remained moderate. Workers waited for a connection and pool acquisition timeouts appeared during traffic peaks.
close_notes: Bounded client concurrency and restored stable pool acquisition latency.
root_cause: Each worker created its own oversized connection pool, allowing aggregate demand to exceed the development database connection budget.
resolution: Reduced per-worker pool size, capped worker concurrency, reused initialized pools, and alerted on acquisition wait time and total sessions.

short_description: Outbound workflow intermittently waits for database connection
description: The contact flow invoked Lambda, but some calls timed out before the outbound request. Function traces showed most delay occurred while acquiring a VPC database connection, and retries often succeeded.
close_notes: Reused VPC database pools and verified outbound calls during concurrency tests.
root_cause: The deployed Lambda created a new VPC database pool for every invocation, saturating available connections and consuming the function timeout before the outbound contact API call.
resolution: Moved pool initialization outside the handler, reduced pool size, limited function concurrency, and added a connection-acquisition timeout shorter than the overall invocation budget.

short_description: Campaign state workers wait for connections during call launch
description: Outbound launch latency rises with concurrent campaign workers. Database acquisition waits appear before calls are requested, while a manual retry during lower traffic usually completes.
